required_changes_injected: Criterion 2 violation: Identified Pain regressed from 7/10 to 5/10 without sufficient justification. The analysis states 'Call 2 reconfirms the same use case without adding sharpness' — but this is carry-forward context with 2 calls reviewed. The prior score of 7/10 was based on a real, stated pain (non-technical teams cannot run experiments independently). Call 2 does not contradict this; it reinforces it ('enabling non-technical teams to run independent experiments'). The regression to 5/10 is justified only by absence of urgency language, but urgency was never present in Call 1 either — the prior 7/10 score already reflected that gap. Either maintain 7/10 with explicit note 'No new information contradicting prior assessment — maintaining 7/10,' or provide a documented reason from Call 2 that actively weakens the pain signal (e.g., prospect stated 'this is not urgent' or 'we deprioritized this'). As written, the regression appears arbitrary. Additionally, Criterion 4: Decision Process next step uses vague language 'ask by end of the trial period' without a specific contact name or concrete action date. Replace with '[contact TBD]: Confirm must-haves vs. nice-to-haves and integration requirements by trial day 4' or similar. All other components meet rubric standards.
